$doc: UI Capability Parity registry — the single source of truth binding every capability that is operable in the Next.js app (apps/app) to the concrete UI that invokes it. Law: a capability that declares the "app" layer in its contract MUST have a binding here whose `page` exists and renders without an error page; and any capability the app actually invokes MUST be declared + bound here. Enforced by `pnpm check:ui-parity` (tools/scripts/check_ui_parity.mjs). Do NOT hand-wave an entry — every binding must carry a runtime proof (screenshot committed under verifications/<session>/, or an e2e spec) captured against a working page.

$binding_shape.route: URL path pattern the human navigates to, e.g. /[orgSlug]/[workspaceSlug]/workbench/tools/mcp
$binding_shape.page: repo-relative page.tsx (or route.ts) that renders/handles the surface
$binding_shape.entry: the concrete UI affordance that invokes the capability (form submit, button, toggle) — human-readable
$binding_shape.testid: optional data-testid on the entry-point element, for e2e assertion
$binding_shape.proof: path to the runtime proof: verifications/<session>/<name>.png OR an apps/app/e2e/<slug>.spec.ts
$binding_shape.verifiedAt: YYYY-MM-DD the proof was captured against a working page
$binding_shape.verifiedBy: session id / agent that captured the proof
